title: EmbeddingManifest
description: Design proposal, not yet implemented (Phase 11). Describes manifest.json, the header artifact for one chapter's embedding output (data/output/<chapter_id>/embeddings/<model_id>/manifest.json), plus the shape of one entry in the sibling records.json. See embedding_design.md for full rationale.

name.description: e.g. 'BAAI/bge-m3' -- the exact model identifier, not a friendly label.

revision.description: Exact model revision/commit (e.g. a HuggingFace repo commit SHA) -- NOT just a version tag, so the precise weights are reproducible (see embedding_design.md §8).

EmbeddingRecord.description: One entry in records.json; row i of vectors.npy corresponds to records[i] -- this positional mapping is itself part of the contract (validated, never assumed -- see embedding_design.md §7).

embedding_id.description: Deterministic: 'emb-<chapter_id>-<chunk_id>-<model_name>-<model_revision>' -- content-derived, never a counter, so the SAME chunk under a DIFFERENT model/revision gets a genuinely different id rather than overwriting.

chunk_id.description: FK to knowledge_chunks.json's own chunk_id -- reused verbatim, never regenerated.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the EXACT embedding input string (not just chunk.text) -- see embedding_design.md §2/§4 for why the input, not the source text, is hashed.

filter_metadata.description: Denormalized, chunk-level fields a future Vector DB would filter/facet on -- copied from the chunk, never re-derived or invented (see embedding_design.md §10).

status.description: 'stale' when a prior run's chunk_id no longer exists in the current knowledge_chunks.json -- the record and its vector are KEPT (never silently deleted) and flagged, per embedding_design.md §5.

source_chunks_hash.description: sha256 of the exact knowledge_chunks.json bytes this manifest was generated from.
